correctness.rationale: Every word has a unique zero-gap decomposition; all nonzero trigrams are determined by gaps capped at two. Every capped triple with a 2 is realized for n>=8. Stars and bars yields a degree-at-most-two polynomial for each lift count. The exhaustive 19/38-template signature comparison has just the two specified collisions and provides all fiber-size patterns; polynomial agreement at n=8,9,10 proves those identities at every n>=8. Exact independent sliding-window enumeration tested 15,120 actual q-ary source words. No finite sample is used as an infinite extrapolation.
